‘Clean the Desk’ Is Not a Goal――まずDoneを定義する

『片づけをする』 sounds like a goal, but it only names an activity. Goal-setting research shows that specific challenging goals often outperform vague do-your-best instructions, while complex unfamiliar tasks may benefit more from learning goals than performance goals. Consulting-style issues are different again: an issue is a question that must be resolved to move toward the desired outcome. 目標＝where to go、イシュー＝what to resolve、タスク＝what to do。この順番にすると、ToDoを書く前にDoneの定義を書ける。
